CACHE::payload
       Returns the HTTP payload of the cache response.

SYNOPSIS
       CACHE::payload

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the HTTP payload of the cache response.

       CACHE::payload

	    * Returns the HTTP payload of the cache response.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       CACHE_RESPONSE

EXAMPLES
	when CACHE_RESPONSE {
	  set payload [CACHE::payload]
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.5 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
